title: Türkiye e-Visa application
before: Check first whether your passport needs a visa at all: Lebanese citizens, for example, can visit for tourism without one.
Use only evisa.gov.tr. Other sites that sell Turkish e-Visas charge extra.
Each traveler, including children, needs their own e-Visa. Have a card ready to pay.

sections.title: Preliminary questions

fields.label: Valid Schengen, US, UK or Irish visa or residence permit

yourself: Your airline, if your passport only qualifies with certain carriers

sections.title: Verify and pay
yourself: Check every value, accept the declaration and pay by card.

after: Download the e-Visa PDF (it's also emailed to you) and keep it on your phone or printed for the border.
Carry your return ticket and hotel booking in case the border officer asks.
Record the e-Visa on your dashboard as submitted and approved.

sources.label: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Türkiye: visa information
